schemes.name: Statutory Sick Pay only
schemes.description: No company sick pay — eligible employees receive SSP at the rate in force on each day.

schemes.name: Rolling Occupational Sick Scheme (Days)
schemes.description: Entitles the employee to 10 days at full pay followed by 5 days at half pay in any rolling 12 month period, assuming a 5 day working week. Entitlement will scale up or down based on the average days per week worked.

schemes.name: Service-based Company Sick Pay
schemes.description: Full and half pay that grows with length of service, renewed each service year.
